title: Cross-section inconsistency
text: Cross-section inconsistency: this assigns AC17’s regression-gate statement to `sweep-effect-evidence.md`, but the smoke runbook requires it in `sweep-real-pr-evidence.md` (line 375). Choose one authoritative artifact and align the implementation step, smoke assertion, and test coverage so implementation does not have to guess.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in aaec1e0, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
